count_rules.native_issues: One event per issue-status page in each native review receipt. Thirty initial v3 events plus one residual v4c page4 event. Some events contain multiple defects;31 is not an atomic bug count.

count_rules.allocation_adjustments: 185 v1 +100 v2 compiler vertical-overflow allocation changes. These are not actual native image defects or proof of visual fit.
count_rules.alternatives: Five alternative builds are separate. Only source10/13/17 intentionally change three-column deliverables to horizontal bands. Shared repairs and data fixes propagate; no extra preferred defects are charged.
